thought.text: All containers started. Let me verify the application endpoints.

reasoning_content:
All containers are up. start.sh finished successfully (IPFS API ready). WebUI is unhealthy but that's likely ollama not started. Wait, ollama service - the docker-compose-ai.yml only has webui, not ollama. Hmm, the guide mentions ollama. Let's check. Actually docker-compose-ai.yml only defines webui. Maybe ollama is defined elsewhere or missing. Let me check docker ps -a and the backend health.

Let me verify the frontend at localhost:3000.
